page_title: LEC 1-1 FIO | Lecce v Fiorentina 20/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+3' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
90+2' Referee Fabio Maresca sees the trip by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
90+1' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
88' The game is interrupted now, Jamil Siebert (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' Lameck Banda (Lecce) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

86' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
85' Lecce are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
85' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Antonino Gallo and he is replaced by Corrie Ndaba (Lecce).
82' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
80' The substitution has been made. Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) has replaced Jack Harrison.
80' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Nicolo Fagioli will be replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina).
80' It is time for a substitution. Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) is on for Cher Ndour.
80' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
79' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
76' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. David de Gea (Fiorentina) is given a yellow card.
76' A clever short pass gives Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
74' A dangerous towering header by Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
73' The referee awards a corner and Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) goes over to take it.
73' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
72' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
72' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

71' 1 - 1 Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Antonino Gallo. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
70' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.

70' Lameck Banda (Lecce) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea made a superb athletic save to deny him.
68' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
68' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
67' The free kick is taken by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), but ball is cleared.
65' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
64' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

64' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. It will be a corner kick for Lecce.
62' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
61' Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
61' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
60' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) replacing Albert Gudmundsson.
57' Here comes a substitution. Omri Gandelman (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Oumar Ngom.
57' Here is a change. Walid Cheddira is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Nikola Stulic (Lecce).
56' It's time for a substitution. Lameck Banda (Lecce) comes on in place of Konan Ndri.
56' Konan Ndri (Lecce) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.

55' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
53' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
50' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is successfully intercepted by the defender.
45+2' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Lecce are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45+1' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+1' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Great solo effort by Oumar Ngom (Lecce) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.

44' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Wladimiro Falcone. This effort really didn't trouble him.
42' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
40' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
38' Dodo (Fiorentina) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Roberto Piccoli.
36' The linesman signals that Walid Cheddira (Lecce) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
35' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

30' 0 - 1 Goal! Rolando Mandragora produces a great pass that finds Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
29' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
25' The ball is cleared after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) but poses no threat.
21' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fabio Maresca saw the whole situation.
20' Half-chance! Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) plays a pass into the box, but David de Gea reacts well to snuff out the attack.

18' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) meets a fine cross inside the penalty area from the resulting free kick and attempts to beat the keeper with a sweet header. That he does, but one of the defenders standing on the goal line manages to stop the effort going inside the right post.
13' Konan Ndri (Lecce) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the left post.
13' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
11' Paolo Vanoli is forced to make a change. Robin Gosens is unable to continue due to injury, Luis Balbo (Fiorentina) comes on.
10' The game is interrupted as Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is flagged offside.
8' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
7' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
7' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
4' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) commits a foul during an attacking move.
3' Wonderful movement by Fiorentina. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Fiorentina will kick-off.
